liebermann.description_de: Mag. Sinicius camerarius pape (Liber censuum eccl. Rom.)
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: The Liber censuum of the Roman Church (sentences brought by Master Sinicius, papal chamberlain, 1267)
liebermann.notes: Master Sinicius, papal chamberlain and nuncio in England, brought to the Curia in 1267 sentences on Peter's Pence from Instituta Cnuti (Ip Hunt class: I Cn Pr., 11) and ECf 10; they stand in the Liber censuum of the Roman church, in Vatican MS Christina reg. 451 (17th century) and in Vc.

entries.text_de: Mag. Sinicius camerarius pape, nuncius in Anglia, ad Curiam detulit [1267] Sätze über Peterspfennig aus In Cn der Classe Ip Hunt (nämlich I Cn Pr., 11) und ECf 10. Sie stehen im Liber censuum eccl. Rom.9 und, hinter Johann’s Lehnseid, in Hs. Rom Vatican Christina reg. 451 vom 17. Jh. und in Vc.
entries.text_en: Mag. Sinicius camerarius pape, nuncius in Anglia, ad Curiam detulit [1267] clauses on Peter's Pence from In Cn of the class Ip Hunt (namely I Cn Pr., 11) and ECf 10. They stand in the Liber censuum eccl. Rom.9 and, after John’s oath of fealty, in MS Rome Vatican Christina reg. 451 of the 17th century and in Vc.
